channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pentagon says 3 Iranian tankers hit after attacks on US warships
item.description: U.S.-Iran fighting intensified after American strikes on three Iranian oil tankers following missile attacks on Navy ships in the Gulf.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] AI boom helps fuel surge in global billionaire wealth, report says
item.description: Altrata says the world had a record 3,795 billionaires in 2025, with collective wealth rising to $15.1 trillion amid the AI boom.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump threatens trade cutoffs if Fed doesn’t lower interest rates
item.description: Trump threatened to cut off trade with countries that run surpluses with the U.S. if the Federal Reserve does not lower interest rates.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] DHS says 380 arrested in Springfield, Ohio, after Haiti TPS protections end
item.description: The apparent suicide of a Haitian college freshman in Ohio has renewed debate over ICE ankle monitors and the end of TPS protections.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Pasco deputies investigating after man found dead in Spring Hill area
item.description: Pasco Sheriff's Office deputies are investigating after a man was found dead Friday in the Spring Hill area, according to deputies.
